stories.headline: Claude API now reports model tool capabilities
stories.summary: Anthropic's Models API now exposes whether a model supports web search and code execution tools. The October 6 update makes capability discovery more reliable than maintaining model-specific assumptions in application code.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful for routing agent tasks to compatible models and dynamically selecting tools.

stories.headline: Rubrik introduces Code Guardian for AI-generated code
stories.summary: Rubrik announced Code Guardian as an expansion of Project Hourglass. The tool is intended to scan AI-generated code for weaknesses within isolated environments, as organizations consider increasingly advanced AI-assisted attacks.
stories.why_it_matters: Another sign that security testing is becoming integral to AI coding workflows.

stories.headline: New Relic announces AI Evaluation for production GenAI
stories.summary: New Relic introduced AI Evaluation to assess generative AI application response quality and security risks. The feature connects evaluation signals with observability traces, helping teams investigate failures across prompts and backend components.
stories.why_it_matters: A useful pattern for observability and evaluation in production RAG and agent platforms.

stories.headline: Zetwerk sets IPO price band and targets $2.64 billion valuation
stories.summary: India's Zetwerk set a price band of ₹143–151 per share for its upcoming offering, Reuters reported on October 12. Public subscription is expected October 15–19, with trading slated to start October 23.
stories.why_it_matters: An important Indian manufacturing and technology-enabled supply-chain listing to track this week.

stories.headline: Indian benchmarks decline despite RBI support for the rupee
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices fell on October 12 amid worries about oil prices and inflation, according to Reuters. The RBI introduced measures aimed at stabilizing the rupee, but investors remained cautious about economic pressures and foreign outflows.
stories.why_it_matters: Oil and currency movements can affect both Indian equities and technology companies' operating costs.
